# ComfyStreamer worker package

This directory contains the pinned generation and upscaling worker runtime,
supporting references, and third-party notices used by SlopTogether.

- `runtime/` is the self-verifying `vast` worker artifact: generation nodes,
  independent SoL upscale nodes, runtime helpers, pins, dependency locks and
  the worker identity extension. Internal research/benchmark notes and the
  upstream-only quickstart are not included in the worker package.
- `reference/` contains the two existing Fal Dockerfiles and staging helpers,
  worker documentation, two workflow snapshots generated by the existing pure
  workflow builders, and focused upstream CPU tests.
- `licenses/` preserves the upstream third-party license and notice files,
  including license filenames omitted by the upstream assembler's extension
  filter. The main project license is in `LICENSE`.

No model weights, videos, images, private credentials, environments, caches,
OBS plugin, coordinator, original website, old build contexts, or benchmark
result directories are included. Several runtime modules are named
`benchmark_*`; they implement the production sampler, decoder and output path
and remain part of the worker. The model-training node and learned-router
support were removed; generation and upscaling mappings used by the recipes
remain available.

The Fal Dockerfiles retain their original paths and app names as references.
New SlopTogether deployment contexts/app names and authenticated job adapters
must be prepared before deployment. This snapshot does not provision GPUs.
The upstream app `pyproject.toml` files and locks are in
`runtime/deploy/fal/{fasth3-b1,h3-sol-upscaler}/`; `reference/deploy/fal/`
contains only the Dockerfiles and generation README. Those separate trees
do not form a ready-to-run Fal deployment directory.

See [worker-import.md](../../docs/worker-import.md) for capabilities,
verification and RTX 4090 qualification gaps.

## Offline checks

Use Python 3.12 or newer; the source uses Python 3.12 syntax. From the
SlopTogether root:

```sh
python3.12 -B vendor/comfystream/runtime/scripts/assemble_worker_artifact.py \
  --profile vast --destination vendor/comfystream/runtime --check

PYTHONPATH=vendor/comfystream/runtime:vendor/comfystream/reference/tests \
  python3.12 -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider \
  vendor/comfystream/reference/tests/test_worker_artifact.py \
  vendor/comfystream/reference/tests/test_fasth3_trim_5step_contract.py \
  -k 'not targeted_docker_and_vast_profiles_consume_canonical_stage'
```

The excluded test requires the original complete deployment repository,
including the Vast bootstrap, which is outside this import's scope. No test
in this check starts an inference worker, downloads models or contacts Fal.
